title: Evaluation of a Novel Endoscopic Treatment for Achalasia
brief_summary: This study is to evaluate outcomes of a less invasive surgical procedure for the treatment of achalasia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* o Subjects with a manometric/radiologic diagnosis of primary achalasia; EGD shows no neoplasm

  * Ability to undergo general anesthesia
  * The subject is \> 18 yrs.of age
  * Ability to give informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* o Sigmoid achalasia

  * Contraindicated for EGD
  * Pregnancy
